prompts.rachel_prompt2: Edit this livery texture for better readability on a 2004 racing-game car. Keep the Rachel/NFSU2-inspired black and dark-purple palette and long aggressive diagonal flow, but simplify the crowded fine hooks into a bold coherent dragon silhouette: one large angular dragon head near the left third, sweeping body and 3 large tail/flame ribbons to the right. Make the main solid silhouette MUCH thicker and taller, with broad opaque black areas, wider purple insets, and a restrained pale silver outline. Overall artwork aspect ratio 4:1, not a skinny 6:1 stripe; fill that 4:1 region with height about 25% of its width, especially in the central half. This is an evolution of Juiced 1's large full-side flame graphics. Flat graphic texture, genuinely transparent background and transparent internal negative spaces. No car render, no letters, no logos, no shadows, no glow, no bevelled metal. Preserve crisp pointed contours. Return one isolated design.
prompts.eclipse_prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Production asset: one flat transparent body-side racing livery for Juiced 1. Reference image is a native Juiced texture sheet; use the broad orange flame graphic at TOP RIGHT for its full-side scale and flowing composition, not its face subject. Transform it into a NEW design inspired by Brian's lime-green Mitsubishi Eclipse from The Fast and the Furious (2001): broad icy silver/white mechanical curves with dark navy-blue shadow shapes and a few electric-blue accents, angular forward spear meeting sweeping organic claw shapes and long speed ribbons. No orange, no face. Large interconnected graphic covering a 4:1 horizontal rectangle, tall central forms occupy most of its height, tapered long ends. Strong coherent silhouette, restrained detail readable on a PS2-era car. Flat vector-like colour blocks, no photorealism, no metallic reflections. Genuine transparent background, transparent gaps, no car, no text, no sponsor logos, no wheel cutouts, no rectangular colour panel. ONE isolated livery only, not a contact sheet.
prompts.supra_prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE transparent flat racing-game body-side vinyl texture. Reference is Juiced 1's texture sheet: transform the TOP RIGHT orange flame-and-character composition into NEW artwork inspired by Brian's orange Toyota Supra from The Fast and the Furious 2001. Keep the native Juiced broad full-side composition and big readable forms. A bold stylized silver-grey mechanical gladiator / robotic warrior profile at the LEFT THIRD, integrated into long sweeping gunmetal charcoal and pale silver speed blades trailing RIGHT, with a few restrained cobalt-blue inset accents. Original new warrior drawing, not a photo; energetic early-2000s airbrush silhouette simplified into crisp game-readable flat shapes. Orange will be car paint; do not include any orange background. Overall artwork 4:1 wide, substantial central height, long tapered ends. Genuine transparent background and cutout negative space. No words, no logos, no car, no wheel holes, no template, no external shadow or glow. Return ONLY one isolated livery texture, not the reference sheet.
prompts.rx7_prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Production texture for a full-side Juiced 1 car livery. Reference sheet shows native Juiced motifs; transform the broad TOP RIGHT flame composition into a NEW early-2000s tuner graphic inspired by Dom's red Mazda RX-7 from The Fast and the Furious 2001: sweeping BOLD BLACK graphic band with sharp hooked blades and long forked tails, silver-grey inner wedges and a few deep graphite divisions. Red will come from the car paint. Restrained muscular graphic, angular flowing flame/spear shapes, no animal face and no human figure. Do NOT make another dragon or a tiny logo. A single large horizontal 4:1 motif, central black band has real height (roughly quarter of total width), tapers dramatically to both ends; the main sweep climbs gently from left low to right high. Crisp graphic silhouette and solid flat ink colours. Transparent background with clear cutout negative space. No car, no photo, no template, no text, no sponsor logos, no wheel cutouts, no shadows or glow. Return ONLY the new isolated livery.
prompts.jetta_prompt: Use case: style-transfer. ONE flat transparent production car-side livery texture for Juiced 1. Reference sheet contains original Juiced graphics: borrow the large side-covering scale and strong diagonal sweep of the TOP RIGHT flame motif, but redesign entirely as a clean geometric racing graphic inspired by Jesse's white Volkswagen Jetta from The Fast and the Furious 2001. Wide cobalt-blue and dark navy angular ribbon panels, parallel silver-grey speed strips, a few small acid-yellow accents. Think structured 2001 touring-car tuner graphics, with bold blocky slanted cuts and flowing horizontal ribbons. No dragon, no flames, no character, no logos or lettering. White will come from the car body, so keep the background genuinely transparent. Artwork fills a 4:1 horizontal composition with tall central shapes and tapered ends; significant side-covering area, not a thin sponsor stripe. Simple crisp solid regions, minimal details, readable at game resolution. No car render, no wheel cutouts, no body-panel template, no floor, no shadow, no glow. Return just the one isolated new graphic.
